howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps to document your Career Mode
howItWorks.step1Text: Choose your club or manager save name. Pro users can have multiple careers; free plan includes one.
howItWorks.step2Text: At the end of a season (or whenever you want), photograph or export EA FC screenshots: player stats, top scorers, etc.
howItWorks.step3Text: Tap Process. You'll see the season newspaper, wall evolution, and build years of history.

faq.q: Do I need a PC or can I use console?
faq.a: Console and mobile work fine. You only need photos or screenshots of in-game stats screens. No need to extract save files.
Screens showing player names and stats: squad, top scorers, assists, clean sheets, etc. The clearer, the better.
No. Legends Tracker is an independent fan project. Not affiliated with EA Sports or EA FC.

faq.q: Why is the first load slow?
faq.a: The free server may be "asleep". The first request can take up to 1 minute. Wait and try again.
Free: careers, chronicles, wall, cloud sync with account. Pro (€1.99/mo, with a 14-day free trial): Real History — compare your players with club historical records.
They're processed to extract data. Not intended as a permanent gallery. More details on the Privacy page.

faq.q: Does it work with EA FC 25 / 26?
faq.a: Yes, with any recent EA FC/FIFA Career Mode version as long as screenshots show readable stats in Spanish or English.
